## WLS Take 3

```{python}
#| label: wls_v3

from sklearn.linear_model import ElasticNetCV
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

# ── WLS v3 — Regularized coefficients + regularized weights ───────────────────
# Diagnosis from v1/v2: overfitting comes from the main model, not the weights.
# Fix: apply ElasticNetCV to the main regression with WLS-style sample weights.
# This regularizes both the variance model AND the coefficient estimation.

# ── Step 1: Re-use regularized weights from v2 ───────────────────────────────
# wls_weights_train_v2 and wls_weights_test_v2 already computed above

# ── Step 2: Scale features for ElasticNet ────────────────────────────────────
scaler_v3 = StandardScaler()
X_train_v3_scaled = scaler_v3.fit_transform(X_train)
X_test_v3_scaled  = scaler_v3.transform(X_test)

# ── Step 3: Fit ElasticNetCV with WLS sample weights ─────────────────────────
# sample_weight in ElasticNet is equivalent to WLS weighting
enet_wls = ElasticNetCV(
    l1_ratio     = [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 0.95, 1.0],
    alphas       = np.logspace(-4, 1, 50),
    cv           = 5,
    max_iter     = 10000,
    random_state = 2026
)
enet_wls.fit(X_train_v3_scaled, y_train, sample_weight=wls_weights_train_v2)

print(f"Best alpha    : {enet_wls.alpha_:.6f}")
print(f"Best l1_ratio : {enet_wls.l1_ratio_:.2f}  (0=Ridge, 1=Lasso)")
print(f"Non-zero coefs: {(enet_wls.coef_ != 0).sum()} / {len(enet_wls.coef_)}")

# ── Step 4: Predictions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
y_pred_wls_v3_train = enet_wls.predict(X_train_v3_scaled)
y_pred_wls_v3_test  = enet_wls.predict(X_test_v3_scaled)

resid_wls_v3 = y_train.values - y_pred_wls_v3_train

ss_res = ((y_test - y_pred_wls_v3_test) ** 2).sum()
ss_tot = ((y_test - y_test.mean()) ** 2).sum()
r2_test_wls_v3  = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
r2_train_wls_v3 = r2_score(y_train, y_pred_wls_v3_train)

print("=" * 50)
print("  WLS v3 — Weighted ElasticNet")
print("=" * 50)
print(f"  Train R²       : {r2_train_wls_v3:.4f}")
print(f"  Test  R²       : {r2_test_wls_v3:.4f}")
print(f"  Train-Test gap : {r2_train_wls_v3 - r2_test_wls_v3:.4f}")
print("=" * 50)

# ── Top coefficients ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
coef_df_v3 = pd.DataFrame({
    "feature"    : X_train.columns,
    "coefficient": enet_wls.coef_
}).query("coefficient != 0").assign(
    abs_coef=lambda d: d["coefficient"].abs()
).sort_values("abs_coef", ascending=False)

print(f"\n  Top 20 predictors by |coefficient|:")
print(coef_df_v3.head(20)[["feature", "coefficient"]].to_string(index=False))

# ── Formal assumption tests ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
dw = sm.stats.stattools.durbin_watson(resid_wls_v3)
bp_stat, bp_p, _, _ = het_breuschpagan(
    resid_wls_v3,
    sm.add_constant(X_train_v3_scaled[:, enet_wls.coef_ != 0])
)

print(f"\n  Residual skew         : {pd.Series(resid_wls_v3).skew():.3f}")
print(f"  Residual kurt         : {pd.Series(resid_wls_v3).kurt():.3f}")
print(f"  Residual std          : {resid_wls_v3.std():.4f}")
print(f"  Durbin-Watson         : {dw:.4f}  (2.0 = no autocorrelation)")
print(f"  Breusch-Pagan p-value : {bp_p:.4f} ({'Heteroscedastic' if bp_p < 0.05 else 'Homoscedastic'})")

# ── Segment labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
seg_labels = pd.Series("Land", index=train.index)
seg_labels[train["is_residential"] == 1] = "Residential"

# ── Diagnostic plots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 10))

axes[0,0].scatter(y_pred_wls_v3_train, resid_wls_v3, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#2980b9")
axes[0,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[0,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted")
axes[0,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[0,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")

sm.qqplot(pd.Series(resid_wls_v3), line="45", fit=True, ax=axes[0,1], alpha=0.3)
axes[0,1].set_title("Normal Q-Q Plot")

sqrt_abs_resid = np.sqrt(np.abs(resid_wls_v3))
axes[0,2].scatter(y_pred_wls_v3_train, sqrt_abs_resid, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#27ae60")
axes[0,2].set_title("Scale-Location (Homoscedasticity)")
axes[0,2].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[0,2].set_ylabel("√|Residuals|")

colors = {"Residential": "#2980b9", "Land": "#f39c12"}
for seg, col in colors.items():
    mask = seg_labels == seg
    axes[1,0].scatter(
        y_pred_wls_v3_train[mask], resid_wls_v3[mask],
        alpha=0.2, s=8, color=col, label=seg
    )
axes[1,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted by Segment")
axes[1,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[1,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")
axes[1,0].legend()

axes[1,1].hist(resid_wls_v3, bins=60, color="#9b59b6", edgecolor="white")
axes[1,1].axvline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,1].set_title("Residual Distribution")
axes[1,1].set_xlabel("Residuals")
axes[1,1].set_ylabel("Count")

axes[1,2].scatter(y_test, y_pred_wls_v3_test, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#e67e22")
axes[1,2].plot([y_test.min(), y_test.max()],
               [y_test.min(), y_test.max()], color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,2].set_title("Actual vs Predicted (Test Set)")
axes[1,2].set_xlabel("Actual ln(Trended_Price)")
axes[1,2].set_ylabel("Predicted ln(Trended_Price)")

plt.suptitle("WLS v3 — Weighted ElasticNet (Regularized Coefficients)", fontsize=14)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# ── Segment-level performance ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
print("\n  Segment-Level Performance:")
print(f"  {'Segment':<15} | {'Train rows':>10} | {'Test rows':>9} | {'Train R²':>8} | {'Test R²':>8}")
print("  " + "-" * 65)
for seg_label, res_val in [("Residential", 1), ("Land", 0)]:
    mask_tr = (train["is_residential"] == res_val).values
    mask_te = (test["is_residential"]  == res_val).values
    y_tr = y_train.values[mask_tr]
    y_te = y_test.values[mask_te]
    y_p_tr = y_pred_wls_v3_train[mask_tr]
    y_p_te = y_pred_wls_v3_test[mask_te]
    ss_r = ((y_te - y_p_te) ** 2).sum()
    ss_t = ((y_te - y_te.mean()) ** 2).sum()
    print(f"  {seg_label:<15} | {mask_tr.sum():>10} | {mask_te.sum():>9} | {r2_score(y_tr, y_p_tr):>8.4f} | {1 - ss_r/ss_t:>8.4f}")

# ── Comparison table ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print("\n\n" + "="*70)
print("COMPARISON: WLS v1 vs v2 vs v3")
print("="*70)
print(f"  {'Model':<45} {'Test R²':<12} {'Train-Test Gap'}")
print("  " + "-"*70)
print(f"  {'WLS v1 (OLS aux weights)':<45} {0.7969:<12.4f} {0.1822:.4f}")
print(f"  {'WLS v2 (ElasticNet aux weights)':<45} {r2_test_wls_v2:<12.4f} {r2_train_wls_v2 - r2_test_wls_v2:.4f}")
print(f"  {'WLS v3 (Weighted ElasticNet main model)':<45} {r2_test_wls_v3:<12.4f} {r2_train_wls_v3 - r2_test_wls_v3:.4f}")
print("="*70)
```

```{python}
#| label: wls_v4

from sklearn.linear_model import ElasticNetCV
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

# ── WLS v4 — Weighted ElasticNet + Segment Interactions ───────────────────────
# Build on v3: same weighted ElasticNet main model, but add segment × key
# predictor interactions (same pattern as OLS v2, ENet v2, etc.)

# ── Add segment interaction terms ─────────────────────────────────────────────
INTERACT_COLS = ["Total SqFt", "Year Built", "Quality_Weighted", "ln_Lot Acres"]

train_wls_v4 = train.copy()
test_wls_v4  = test.copy()

for col in INTERACT_COLS:
    if col in X_train.columns:
        train_wls_v4[f"res_x_{col}"] = X_train["is_residential"] * X_train[col]
        test_wls_v4[f"res_x_{col}"]  = X_test["is_residential"]  * X_test[col]

# ── Add polynomial terms ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
POLY_COLS = ["Total SqFt", "Year Built"]

for col in POLY_COLS:
    if col in X_train.columns:
        train_wls_v4[f"{col}_sq"] = X_train[col] ** 2
        test_wls_v4[f"{col}_sq"]  = X_test[col] ** 2

# ── Rebuild X matrices ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
EXCLUDE = ["Trended_Price", "ln_Trended_Price"]
X_train_wls_v4 = train_wls_v4.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).drop(columns=EXCLUDE, errors="ignore").fillna(0)
X_test_wls_v4  = test_wls_v4.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).drop(columns=EXCLUDE, errors="ignore").fillna(0)
X_test_wls_v4  = X_test_wls_v4.reindex(columns=X_train_wls_v4.columns, fill_value=0)

print(f"Predictors v3 : {X_train.shape[1]}")
print(f"Predictors v4 : {X_train_wls_v4.shape[1]}  (+{X_train_wls_v4.shape[1] - X_train.shape[1]} interaction/poly terms)")

# ── Re-estimate weights on expanded feature set ───────────────────────────────
# Refit aux variance model on the new feature set for accurate weights
scaler_aux_v4 = StandardScaler()
X_train_aux_v4_scaled = scaler_aux_v4.fit_transform(X_train_wls_v4)
X_test_aux_v4_scaled  = scaler_aux_v4.transform(X_test_wls_v4)

ols_init_v4 = sm.OLS(y_train, sm.add_constant(X_train_wls_v4)).fit()
log_resid_sq_v4 = np.log(ols_init_v4.resid ** 2 + 1e-10)

aux_enet_v4 = ElasticNetCV(
    l1_ratio     = [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 0.95, 1.0],
    alphas       = np.logspace(-4, 1, 50),
    cv           = 5,
    max_iter     = 10000,
    random_state = 2026
)
aux_enet_v4.fit(X_train_aux_v4_scaled, log_resid_sq_v4)

fitted_var_train_v4 = np.exp(aux_enet_v4.predict(X_train_aux_v4_scaled))
fitted_var_test_v4  = np.exp(aux_enet_v4.predict(X_test_aux_v4_scaled))

var_cap_v4 = np.percentile(fitted_var_train_v4, 99)
fitted_var_train_v4 = np.clip(fitted_var_train_v4, 1e-6, var_cap_v4)
fitted_var_test_v4  = np.clip(fitted_var_test_v4,  1e-6, var_cap_v4)

wls_weights_train_v4 = 1 / fitted_var_train_v4
wls_weights_test_v4  = 1 / fitted_var_test_v4

print(f"\n  Weight summary (train):")
print(f"  Min    : {wls_weights_train_v4.min():.4f}")
print(f"  Median : {np.median(wls_weights_train_v4):.4f}")
print(f"  Max    : {wls_weights_train_v4.max():.4f}")

# ── Fit Weighted ElasticNet main model ────────────────────────────────────────
scaler_v4 = StandardScaler()
X_train_v4_scaled = scaler_v4.fit_transform(X_train_wls_v4)
X_test_v4_scaled  = scaler_v4.transform(X_test_wls_v4)

enet_wls_v4 = ElasticNetCV(
    l1_ratio     = [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 0.95, 1.0],
    alphas       = np.logspace(-4, 1, 50),
    cv           = 5,
    max_iter     = 10000,
    random_state = 2026
)
enet_wls_v4.fit(X_train_v4_scaled, y_train, sample_weight=wls_weights_train_v4)

print(f"\nBest alpha    : {enet_wls_v4.alpha_:.6f}")
print(f"Best l1_ratio : {enet_wls_v4.l1_ratio_:.2f}")
print(f"Non-zero coefs: {(enet_wls_v4.coef_ != 0).sum()} / {len(enet_wls_v4.coef_)}")

# ── Predictions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
y_pred_wls_v4_train = enet_wls_v4.predict(X_train_v4_scaled)
y_pred_wls_v4_test  = enet_wls_v4.predict(X_test_v4_scaled)

resid_wls_v4 = y_train.values - y_pred_wls_v4_train

ss_res = ((y_test - y_pred_wls_v4_test) ** 2).sum()
ss_tot = ((y_test - y_test.mean()) ** 2).sum()
r2_test_wls_v4  = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
r2_train_wls_v4 = r2_score(y_train, y_pred_wls_v4_train)

print("=" * 50)
print("  WLS v4 — Weighted ElasticNet + Seg Interactions")
print("=" * 50)
print(f"  Train R²       : {r2_train_wls_v4:.4f}")
print(f"  Test  R²       : {r2_test_wls_v4:.4f}")
print(f"  Train-Test gap : {r2_train_wls_v4 - r2_test_wls_v4:.4f}")
print("=" * 50)

# ── Top coefficients ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
coef_df_v4 = pd.DataFrame({
    "feature"    : X_train_wls_v4.columns,
    "coefficient": enet_wls_v4.coef_
}).query("coefficient != 0").assign(
    abs_coef=lambda d: d["coefficient"].abs()
).sort_values("abs_coef", ascending=False)

print(f"\n  Top 20 predictors by |coefficient|:")
print(coef_df_v4.head(20)[["feature", "coefficient"]].to_string(index=False))

# ── Formal assumption tests ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
dw = sm.stats.stattools.durbin_watson(resid_wls_v4)
bp_stat, bp_p, _, _ = het_breuschpagan(
    resid_wls_v4,
    sm.add_constant(X_train_v4_scaled[:, enet_wls_v4.coef_ != 0])
)

print(f"\n  Residual skew         : {pd.Series(resid_wls_v4).skew():.3f}")
print(f"  Residual kurt         : {pd.Series(resid_wls_v4).kurt():.3f}")
print(f"  Residual std          : {resid_wls_v4.std():.4f}")
print(f"  Durbin-Watson         : {dw:.4f}  (2.0 = no autocorrelation)")
print(f"  Breusch-Pagan p-value : {bp_p:.4f} ({'Heteroscedastic' if bp_p < 0.05 else 'Homoscedastic'})")

# ── Segment labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
seg_labels = pd.Series("Land", index=train.index)
seg_labels[train["is_residential"] == 1] = "Residential"

# ── Diagnostic plots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 10))

axes[0,0].scatter(y_pred_wls_v4_train, resid_wls_v4, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#2980b9")
axes[0,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[0,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted")
axes[0,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[0,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")

sm.qqplot(pd.Series(resid_wls_v4), line="45", fit=True, ax=axes[0,1], alpha=0.3)
axes[0,1].set_title("Normal Q-Q Plot")

sqrt_abs_resid = np.sqrt(np.abs(resid_wls_v4))
axes[0,2].scatter(y_pred_wls_v4_train, sqrt_abs_resid, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#27ae60")
axes[0,2].set_title("Scale-Location (Homoscedasticity)")
axes[0,2].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[0,2].set_ylabel("√|Residuals|")

colors = {"Residential": "#2980b9", "Land": "#f39c12"}
for seg, col in colors.items():
    mask = seg_labels == seg
    axes[1,0].scatter(
        y_pred_wls_v4_train[mask], resid_wls_v4[mask],
        alpha=0.2, s=8, color=col, label=seg
    )
axes[1,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted by Segment")
axes[1,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[1,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")
axes[1,0].legend()

axes[1,1].hist(resid_wls_v4, bins=60, color="#9b59b6", edgecolor="white")
axes[1,1].axvline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,1].set_title("Residual Distribution")
axes[1,1].set_xlabel("Residuals")
axes[1,1].set_ylabel("Count")

axes[1,2].scatter(y_test, y_pred_wls_v4_test, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#e67e22")
axes[1,2].plot([y_test.min(), y_test.max()],
               [y_test.min(), y_test.max()], color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,2].set_title("Actual vs Predicted (Test Set)")
axes[1,2].set_xlabel("Actual ln(Trended_Price)")
axes[1,2].set_ylabel("Predicted ln(Trended_Price)")

plt.suptitle("WLS v4 — Weighted ElasticNet + Segment Interactions", fontsize=14)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# ── Segment-level performance ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
print("\n  Segment-Level Performance:")
print(f"  {'Segment':<15} | {'Train rows':>10} | {'Test rows':>9} | {'Train R²':>8} | {'Test R²':>8}")
print("  " + "-" * 65)
for seg_label, res_val in [("Residential", 1), ("Land", 0)]:
    mask_tr = (train["is_residential"] == res_val).values
    mask_te = (test["is_residential"]  == res_val).values
    y_tr = y_train.values[mask_tr]
    y_te = y_test.values[mask_te]
    y_p_tr = y_pred_wls_v4_train[mask_tr]
    y_p_te = y_pred_wls_v4_test[mask_te]
    ss_r = ((y_te - y_p_te) ** 2).sum()
    ss_t = ((y_te - y_te.mean()) ** 2).sum()
    print(f"  {seg_label:<15} | {mask_tr.sum():>10} | {mask_te.sum():>9} | {r2_score(y_tr, y_p_tr):>8.4f} | {1 - ss_r/ss_t:>8.4f}")

# ── Comparison table ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print("\n\n" + "="*70)
print("COMPARISON: WLS v1 through v4")
print("="*70)
print(f"  {'Model':<50} {'Test R²':<12} {'Train-Test Gap'}")
print("  " + "-"*70)
print(f"  {'WLS v1 (OLS aux weights)':<50} {0.7969:<12.4f} {0.1822:.4f}")
print(f"  {'WLS v2 (ElasticNet aux weights)':<50} {r2_test_wls_v2:<12.4f} {r2_train_wls_v2 - r2_test_wls_v2:.4f}")
print(f"  {'WLS v3 (Weighted ElasticNet main)':<50} {r2_test_wls_v3:<12.4f} {r2_train_wls_v3 - r2_test_wls_v3:.4f}")
print(f"  {'WLS v4 (+ Segment Interactions)':<50} {r2_test_wls_v4:<12.4f} {r2_train_wls_v4 - r2_test_wls_v4:.4f}")
print("="*70)
```

```{python}
from sklearn.linear_model import ElasticNetCV
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

# ── WLS v5 — Weighted ElasticNet + Segment + City Interactions ────────────────
# Build on v4: add city slope interactions for eligible cities (100+ rows)
# Note: reuses v4 weights — refitting aux model on 158 features causes
# convergence issues; v4 weights estimated on nearly identical feature set.

# ── Start from v4 feature set ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
train_wls_v5 = train_wls_v4.copy()
test_wls_v5  = test_wls_v4.copy()

# ── Identify eligible city dummies ────────────────────────────────────────────
city_dummies    = [c for c in X_train_wls_v4.columns if c.startswith("City_")]
city_counts     = {c: int(X_train_wls_v4[c].sum()) for c in city_dummies}
eligible_cities = [c for c, n in city_counts.items() if n >= 100]
sparse_cities   = [c for c, n in city_counts.items() if n < 100]

print(f"Eligible cities for slope interactions ({len(eligible_cities)}):")
for c in eligible_cities:
    print(f"  {c:<40} : {city_counts[c]:>4} rows")

print(f"\nSparse cities (intercept only) ({len(sparse_cities)}):")
for c in sparse_cities:
    print(f"  {c:<40} : {city_counts[c]:>4} rows")

# ── Add city × key predictor interactions ─────────────────────────────────────
GEO_INTERACT_COLS = ["Total SqFt", "Quality_Weighted", "ln_Lot Acres", "Year Built"]

city_interaction_count = 0
for city_col in eligible_cities:
    for pred_col in GEO_INTERACT_COLS:
        if pred_col in X_train_wls_v4.columns:
            col_name = f"{city_col}_x_{pred_col}".replace(" ", "_")
            train_wls_v5[col_name] = X_train_wls_v4[city_col] * X_train_wls_v4[pred_col]
            test_wls_v5[col_name]  = X_test_wls_v4[city_col]  * X_test_wls_v4[pred_col]
            city_interaction_count += 1

# ── Rebuild X matrices ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
EXCLUDE = ["Trended_Price", "ln_Trended_Price"]
X_train_wls_v5 = train_wls_v5.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).drop(columns=EXCLUDE, errors="ignore").fillna(0)
X_test_wls_v5  = test_wls_v5.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).drop(columns=EXCLUDE, errors="ignore").fillna(0)
X_test_wls_v5  = X_test_wls_v5.reindex(columns=X_train_wls_v5.columns, fill_value=0)

print(f"\nPredictors v4 : {X_train_wls_v4.shape[1]}")
print(f"Predictors v5 : {X_train_wls_v5.shape[1]}  (+{city_interaction_count} city interaction terms)")

# ── Reuse v4 weights (aux model stable, only 16 new city terms added) ─────────
# Refitting the aux variance model on 158 features causes convergence issues.
# v4 weights are estimated on a nearly identical feature set and are stable.
wls_weights_train_v5 = wls_weights_train_v4
wls_weights_test_v5  = wls_weights_test_v4

print(f"\n  Reusing v4 weights for v5 (stable, convergence-safe)")
print(f"  Weight summary (train):")
print(f"  Min    : {wls_weights_train_v5.min():.4f}")
print(f"  Median : {np.median(wls_weights_train_v5):.4f}")
print(f"  Max    : {wls_weights_train_v5.max():.4f}")

# ── Fit Weighted ElasticNet main model ────────────────────────────────────────
scaler_v5 = StandardScaler()
X_train_v5_scaled = scaler_v5.fit_transform(X_train_wls_v5)
X_test_v5_scaled  = scaler_v5.transform(X_test_wls_v5)

enet_wls_v5 = ElasticNetCV(
    l1_ratio     = [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 0.95, 1.0],
    alphas       = np.logspace(-4, 1, 50),
    cv           = 5,
    max_iter     = 100000,
    tol          = 1e-4,
    random_state = 2026,
    n_jobs       = -1
)
enet_wls_v5.fit(X_train_v5_scaled, y_train, sample_weight=wls_weights_train_v5)

print(f"\nBest alpha    : {enet_wls_v5.alpha_:.6f}")
print(f"Best l1_ratio : {enet_wls_v5.l1_ratio_:.2f}")
print(f"Non-zero coefs: {(enet_wls_v5.coef_ != 0).sum()} / {len(enet_wls_v5.coef_)}")

# ── Predictions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
y_pred_wls_v5_train = enet_wls_v5.predict(X_train_v5_scaled)
y_pred_wls_v5_test  = enet_wls_v5.predict(X_test_v5_scaled)

print(f"  {'WLS v3 (Weighted ElasticNet main)':<50} {r2_test_wls_v3:<12.4f} {r2_train_wls_v3 - r2_test_wls_v3:.4f}")

print(f"  {'WLS v5 (+ Seg + City Interactions)':<50} {r2_test_wls_v5:<12.4f} {r2_train_wls_v5 - r2_test_wls_v5:.4f}")
print("="*70)
```

## GAM

```{python}
#| label: gam_v1

from pygam import LinearGAM, s, l
from functools import reduce
import operator

# ── GAM v1 — Baseline ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# ── Identify spline vs linear columns ────────────────────────────────────────
SPLINE_COLS = ["Total SqFt", "Year Built", "ln_Lot Acres", "Quality_Weighted"]
spline_cols = [c for c in SPLINE_COLS if c in X_train.columns]
linear_cols = [c for c in X_train.columns if c not in spline_cols]

spline_idx  = [list(X_train.columns).index(c) for c in spline_cols]
linear_idx  = [list(X_train.columns).index(c) for c in linear_cols]

print(f"Spline terms  : {len(spline_cols)} — {spline_cols}")
print(f"Linear terms  : {len(linear_cols)} predictors")
print(f"Total         : {X_train.shape[1]} predictors")

# ── Build GAM formula ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
spline_terms = reduce(operator.add, [s(i, n_splines=20) for i in spline_idx])
linear_terms = reduce(operator.add, [l(i) for i in linear_idx])
gam_formula  = spline_terms + linear_terms

# ── Fit GAM v1 with wider lambda grid ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Default gridsearch undershoots with 136 terms — search much higher lam values
gam_v1 = LinearGAM(gam_formula)
lam_grid = np.logspace(-3, 5, 30)  # search 0.001 → 100000
gam_v1.gridsearch(
    X_train.values, y_train.values,
    lam=lam_grid,
    progress=False
)

best_lam = np.unique([round(float(l[0]), 6) for l in gam_v1.lam])
print(f"\nBest smoothing lambda : {best_lam}")

# ── Predictions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
y_pred_gam_v1_train = gam_v1.predict(X_train.values)
y_pred_gam_v1_test  = gam_v1.predict(X_test.values)

resid_gam_v1 = y_train.values - y_pred_gam_v1_train

ss_res = ((y_test.values - y_pred_gam_v1_test) ** 2).sum()
ss_tot = ((y_test.values - y_test.values.mean()) ** 2).sum()
r2_test_gam_v1  = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
r2_train_gam_v1 = r2_score(y_train, y_pred_gam_v1_train)

print("=" * 50)
print("  GAM v1 — Baseline")
print("=" * 50)
print(f"  Train R²       : {r2_train_gam_v1:.4f}")
print(f"  Test  R²       : {r2_test_gam_v1:.4f}")
print(f"  Train-Test gap : {r2_train_gam_v1 - r2_test_gam_v1:.4f}")
print(f"  GCV Score      : {gam_v1.statistics_['GCV']:.4f}")
print("=" * 50)

# ── Formal assumption tests ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
dw = sm.stats.stattools.durbin_watson(resid_gam_v1)
bp_stat, bp_p, _, _ = het_breuschpagan(resid_gam_v1, sm.add_constant(X_train.values))

print(f"\n  Residual skew         : {pd.Series(resid_gam_v1).skew():.3f}")
print(f"  Residual kurt         : {pd.Series(resid_gam_v1).kurt():.3f}")
print(f"  Residual std          : {resid_gam_v1.std():.4f}")
print(f"  Durbin-Watson         : {dw:.4f}  (2.0 = no autocorrelation)")
print(f"  Breusch-Pagan p-value : {bp_p:.4f} ({'Heteroscedastic' if bp_p < 0.05 else 'Homoscedastic'})")

# ── Partial dependence plots ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(spline_cols), figsize=(5 * len(spline_cols), 4))
for i, (col, idx) in enumerate(zip(spline_cols, spline_idx)):
    XX = gam_v1.generate_X_grid(term=i)
    axes[i].plot(XX[:, idx], gam_v1.partial_dependence(term=i, X=XX))
    axes[i].plot(XX[:, idx], gam_v1.partial_dependence(term=i, X=XX, width=0.95)[1],
                 c="r", ls="--", alpha=0.5)
    axes[i].set_title(f"Spline: {col}")
    axes[i].set_xlabel(col)
    axes[i].set_ylabel("Partial Effect on ln(Price)")
plt.suptitle("GAM v1 — Partial Dependence (Spline Terms)", fontsize=13)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# ── Segment labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
seg_labels = pd.Series("Land", index=train.index)
seg_labels[train["is_residential"] == 1] = "Residential"

# ── Diagnostic plots (scipy workaround for Positron autoreload bug) ───────────
from scipy import stats as scipy_stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import statsmodels.graphics.gofplots as sm_gof
```

## GAM Take 2 (GAM + Elastic Net)

```{python}
#| label: gam_v1

from pygam import LinearGAM, s
from functools import reduce
import operator
from sklearn.linear_model import ElasticNetCV
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from scipy import stats as scipy_stats

# ── GAM v1 — Two-Stage Hybrid ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Stage 1: ElasticNet on all NON-spline predictors → captures linear structure
# Stage 2: GAM splines on 4 key continuous predictors + Stage 1 residuals
#           → captures nonlinearity that ElasticNet can't

# ── Define spline vs linear columns ──────────────────────────────────────────
SPLINE_COLS = ["Total SqFt", "Year Built", "ln_Lot Acres", "Quality_Weighted"]
spline_cols = [c for c in SPLINE_COLS if c in X_train.columns]
linear_cols = [c for c in X_train.columns if c not in spline_cols]

print(f"Stage 1 (ElasticNet) : {len(linear_cols)} predictors")
print(f"Stage 2 (GAM splines): {len(spline_cols)} — {spline_cols}")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STAGE 1 — ElasticNet on linear predictors
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
X_train_linear = X_train[linear_cols].values
X_test_linear  = X_test[linear_cols].values

scaler_stage1 = StandardScaler()
X_train_linear_scaled = scaler_stage1.fit_transform(X_train_linear)
X_test_linear_scaled  = scaler_stage1.transform(X_test_linear)

enet_stage1 = ElasticNetCV(
    l1_ratio     = [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 0.95, 1.0],
    alphas       = np.logspace(-4, 1, 50),
    cv           = 5,
    max_iter     = 10000,
    random_state = 2026
)
enet_stage1.fit(X_train_linear_scaled, y_train)

y_stage1_train = enet_stage1.predict(X_train_linear_scaled)
y_stage1_test  = enet_stage1.predict(X_test_linear_scaled)

resid_stage1_train = y_train.values - y_stage1_train

print(f"\nStage 1 complete:")
print(f"  Alpha        : {enet_stage1.alpha_:.6f}")
print(f"  L1 ratio     : {enet_stage1.l1_ratio_:.2f}")
print(f"  Non-zero     : {(enet_stage1.coef_ != 0).sum()} / {len(enet_stage1.coef_)}")
print(f"  Train R²     : {r2_score(y_train, y_stage1_train):.4f}")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STAGE 2 — GAM on spline predictors, target = Stage 1 residuals
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
X_train_spline = X_train[spline_cols].values
X_test_spline  = X_test[spline_cols].values

spline_idx = list(range(len(spline_cols)))
gam_terms  = reduce(operator.add, [s(i, n_splines=20) for i in spline_idx])

gam_stage2 = LinearGAM(gam_terms)
lam_grid   = np.logspace(-3, 5, 40)
gam_stage2.gridsearch(
    X_train_spline, resid_stage1_train,
    lam=lam_grid,
    progress=False
)

best_lam = np.unique([round(float(l[0]), 4) for l in gam_stage2.lam])
print(f"\nStage 2 complete:")
print(f"  Best lambda  : {best_lam}")
print(f"  GCV Score    : {gam_stage2.statistics_['GCV']:.6f}")

# ── Combined predictions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
y_spline_correction_train = gam_stage2.predict(X_train_spline)
y_spline_correction_test  = gam_stage2.predict(X_test_spline)

y_pred_gam_v1_train = y_stage1_train + y_spline_correction_train
y_pred_gam_v1_test  = y_stage1_test  + y_spline_correction_test

resid_gam_v1 = y_train.values - y_pred_gam_v1_train

ss_res = ((y_test.values - y_pred_gam_v1_test) ** 2).sum()
ss_tot = ((y_test.values - y_test.values.mean()) ** 2).sum()
r2_test_gam_v1  = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
r2_train_gam_v1 = r2_score(y_train, y_pred_gam_v1_train)

print("\n" + "=" * 50)
print("  GAM v1 — Two-Stage Hybrid")
print("=" * 50)
print(f"  Stage 1 Train R² (ElasticNet) : {r2_score(y_train, y_stage1_train):.4f}")
print(f"  Stage 2 correction added      : {r2_score(resid_stage1_train, y_spline_correction_train):.4f} R² of residuals explained")
print(f"  Combined Train R²             : {r2_train_gam_v1:.4f}")
print(f"  Combined Test  R²             : {r2_test_gam_v1:.4f}")
print(f"  Train-Test gap                : {r2_train_gam_v1 - r2_test_gam_v1:.4f}")
print("=" * 50)

# ── Formal assumption tests ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
dw = sm.stats.stattools.durbin_watson(resid_gam_v1)
bp_stat, bp_p, _, _ = het_breuschpagan(resid_gam_v1, sm.add_constant(X_train.values))

print(f"\n  Residual skew         : {pd.Series(resid_gam_v1).skew():.3f}")
print(f"  Residual kurt         : {pd.Series(resid_gam_v1).kurt():.3f}")
print(f"  Residual std          : {resid_gam_v1.std():.4f}")
print(f"  Durbin-Watson         : {dw:.4f}  (2.0 = no autocorrelation)")
print(f"  Breusch-Pagan p-value : {bp_p:.4f} ({'Heteroscedastic' if bp_p < 0.05 else 'Homoscedastic'})")

# ── Partial dependence plots (spline terms) ───────────────────────────────────
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(spline_cols), figsize=(5 * len(spline_cols), 4))
for i, col in enumerate(spline_cols):
    XX = gam_stage2.generate_X_grid(term=i)
    axes[i].plot(XX[:, i], gam_stage2.partial_dependence(term=i, X=XX))
    axes[i].plot(XX[:, i], gam_stage2.partial_dependence(term=i, X=XX, width=0.95)[1],
                 c="r", ls="--", alpha=0.5)
    axes[i].set_title(f"Spline: {col}")
    axes[i].set_xlabel(col)
    axes[i].set_ylabel("Nonlinear Correction")
plt.suptitle("GAM v1 — Partial Dependence of Spline Corrections", fontsize=13)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# ── Segment labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
seg_labels = pd.Series("Land", index=train.index)
seg_labels[train["is_residential"] == 1] = "Residential"

# ── Diagnostic plots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 10))

axes[0,0].scatter(y_pred_gam_v1_train, resid_gam_v1, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#2980b9")
axes[0,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[0,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted")
axes[0,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[0,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")

(osm, osr), (slope, intercept, r) = scipy_stats.probplot(resid_gam_v1, dist="norm")
axes[0,1].scatter(osm, osr, alpha=0.3, s=8, color="#2980b9")
axes[0,1].plot(osm, slope * np.array(osm) + intercept, color="red")
axes[0,1].set_title("Normal Q-Q Plot")
axes[0,1].set_xlabel("Theoretical Quantiles")
axes[0,1].set_ylabel("Sample Quantiles")

sqrt_abs_resid = np.sqrt(np.abs(resid_gam_v1))
axes[0,2].scatter(y_pred_gam_v1_train, sqrt_abs_resid, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#27ae60")
axes[0,2].set_title("Scale-Location (Homoscedasticity)")
axes[0,2].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[0,2].set_ylabel("√|Residuals|")

colors = {"Residential": "#2980b9", "Land": "#f39c12"}
for seg, col in colors.items():
    mask = seg_labels == seg
    axes[1,0].scatter(
        y_pred_gam_v1_train[mask], resid_gam_v1[mask],
        alpha=0.2, s=8, color=col, label=seg
    )
axes[1,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted by Segment")
axes[1,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[1,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")
axes[1,0].legend()

axes[1,1].hist(resid_gam_v1, bins=60, color="#9b59b6", edgecolor="white")
axes[1,1].axvline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,1].set_title("Residual Distribution")
axes[1,1].set_xlabel("Residuals")

axes[1,2].scatter(y_test, y_pred_gam_v1_test, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#e67e22")
axes[1,2].plot([y_test.min(), y_test.max()],
               [y_test.min(), y_test.max()], color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,2].set_title("Actual vs Predicted (Test Set)")
axes[1,2].set_xlabel("Actual ln(Trended_Price)")
axes[1,2].set_ylabel("Predicted ln(Trended_Price)")

plt.suptitle("GAM v1 — Two-Stage Hybrid Full Diagnostics", fontsize=14)
plt.tight_layout()
```

## GAM Take 3

```{python}
#| label: gam_v2

from pygam import LinearGAM, s
from functools import reduce
import operator
from sklearn.linear_model import ElasticNetCV
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from scipy import stats as scipy_stats

# ── GAM v2 — Two-Stage Hybrid + Segment Interactions ─────────────────────────
# Same structure as v1 but Stage 1 ElasticNet gets segment interaction terms
# and polynomial terms added to the linear feature set

# ── Define spline vs linear columns ──────────────────────────────────────────
SPLINE_COLS = ["Total SqFt", "Year Built", "ln_Lot Acres", "Quality_Weighted"]
spline_cols = [c for c in SPLINE_COLS if c in X_train.columns]

# ── Build expanded linear feature set with segment interactions ───────────────
train_gam_v2 = train.copy()
test_gam_v2  = test.copy()

INTERACT_COLS = ["Total SqFt", "Year Built", "Quality_Weighted", "ln_Lot Acres"]
for col in INTERACT_COLS:
    if col in X_train.columns:
        train_gam_v2[f"res_x_{col}"] = X_train["is_residential"] * X_train[col]
        test_gam_v2[f"res_x_{col}"]  = X_test["is_residential"]  * X_test[col]

POLY_COLS = ["Total SqFt", "Year Built"]
for col in POLY_COLS:
    if col in X_train.columns:
        train_gam_v2[f"{col}_sq"] = X_train[col] ** 2
        test_gam_v2[f"{col}_sq"]  = X_test[col] ** 2

# ── Rebuild X matrices ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
EXCLUDE = ["Trended_Price", "ln_Trended_Price"]
X_train_v2_all = train_gam_v2.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).drop(columns=EXCLUDE, errors="ignore").fillna(0)
X_test_v2_all  = test_gam_v2.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).drop(columns=EXCLUDE, errors="ignore").fillna(0)
X_test_v2_all  = X_test_v2_all.reindex(columns=X_train_v2_all.columns, fill_value=0)

# ── Split into linear (Stage 1) vs spline (Stage 2) ──────────────────────────
linear_cols_v2 = [c for c in X_train_v2_all.columns if c not in spline_cols]

X_train_linear_v2 = X_train_v2_all[linear_cols_v2].values
X_test_linear_v2  = X_test_v2_all[linear_cols_v2].values
X_train_spline_v2 = X_train_v2_all[spline_cols].values
X_test_spline_v2  = X_test_v2_all[spline_cols].values

print(f"Stage 1 (ElasticNet) : {len(linear_cols_v2)} predictors  (+interactions/poly vs v1)")
print(f"Stage 2 (GAM splines): {len(spline_cols)} — {spline_cols}")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STAGE 1 — ElasticNet with segment interactions
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
scaler_stage1_v2 = StandardScaler()
X_train_linear_v2_scaled = scaler_stage1_v2.fit_transform(X_train_linear_v2)
X_test_linear_v2_scaled  = scaler_stage1_v2.transform(X_test_linear_v2)

enet_stage1_v2 = ElasticNetCV(
    l1_ratio     = [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 0.95, 1.0],
    alphas       = np.logspace(-4, 1, 50),
    cv           = 5,
    max_iter     = 10000,
    random_state = 2026
)
enet_stage1_v2.fit(X_train_linear_v2_scaled, y_train)

y_stage1_v2_train = enet_stage1_v2.predict(X_train_linear_v2_scaled)
y_stage1_v2_test  = enet_stage1_v2.predict(X_test_linear_v2_scaled)
resid_stage1_v2   = y_train.values - y_stage1_v2_train

print(f"\nStage 1 complete:")
print(f"  Alpha        : {enet_stage1_v2.alpha_:.6f}")
print(f"  L1 ratio     : {enet_stage1_v2.l1_ratio_:.2f}")
print(f"  Non-zero     : {(enet_stage1_v2.coef_ != 0).sum()} / {len(enet_stage1_v2.coef_)}")
print(f"  Train R²     : {r2_score(y_train, y_stage1_v2_train):.4f}")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STAGE 2 — GAM splines on Stage 1 residuals
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
spline_idx = list(range(len(spline_cols)))
gam_terms  = reduce(operator.add, [s(i, n_splines=20) for i in spline_idx])

gam_stage2_v2 = LinearGAM(gam_terms)
lam_grid      = np.logspace(-3, 5, 40)
gam_stage2_v2.gridsearch(
    X_train_spline_v2, resid_stage1_v2,
    lam=lam_grid,
    progress=False
)

best_lam = np.unique([round(float(l[0]), 4) for l in gam_stage2_v2.lam])
print(f"\nStage 2 complete:")
print(f"  Best lambda  : {best_lam}")
print(f"  GCV Score    : {gam_stage2_v2.statistics_['GCV']:.6f}")

# ── Combined predictions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
y_spline_v2_train = gam_stage2_v2.predict(X_train_spline_v2)
y_spline_v2_test  = gam_stage2_v2.predict(X_test_spline_v2)

y_pred_gam_v2_train = y_stage1_v2_train + y_spline_v2_train
y_pred_gam_v2_test  = y_stage1_v2_test  + y_spline_v2_test

resid_gam_v2 = y_train.values - y_pred_gam_v2_train

ss_res = ((y_test.values - y_pred_gam_v2_test) ** 2).sum()
ss_tot = ((y_test.values - y_test.values.mean()) ** 2).sum()
r2_test_gam_v2  = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
r2_train_gam_v2 = r2_score(y_train, y_pred_gam_v2_train)

print("\n" + "=" * 50)
print("  GAM v2 — Two-Stage + Segment Interactions")
print("=" * 50)
print(f"  Stage 1 Train R² (ElasticNet) : {r2_score(y_train, y_stage1_v2_train):.4f}")
print(f"  Stage 2 correction added      : {r2_score(resid_stage1_v2, y_spline_v2_train):.4f} R² of residuals explained")
print(f"  Combined Train R²             : {r2_train_gam_v2:.4f}")
print(f"  Combined Test  R²             : {r2_test_gam_v2:.4f}")
print(f"  Train-Test gap                : {r2_train_gam_v2 - r2_test_gam_v2:.4f}")
print(f"\n  GAM v1 Test R²               : 0.7904  (baseline)")
print(f"  GAM v2 Test R²               : {r2_test_gam_v2:.4f}  (+ segment interactions)")
print(f"  Improvement                  : {r2_test_gam_v2 - 0.7904:+.4f}")
print("=" * 50)

# ── Formal assumption tests ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
dw = sm.stats.stattools.durbin_watson(resid_gam_v2)
bp_stat, bp_p, _, _ = het_breuschpagan(resid_gam_v2, sm.add_constant(X_train_v2_all.values))

print(f"\n  Residual skew         : {pd.Series(resid_gam_v2).skew():.3f}")
print(f"  Residual kurt         : {pd.Series(resid_gam_v2).kurt():.3f}")
print(f"  Residual std          : {resid_gam_v2.std():.4f}")
print(f"  Durbin-Watson         : {dw:.4f}  (2.0 = no autocorrelation)")
print(f"  Breusch-Pagan p-value : {bp_p:.4f} ({'Heteroscedastic' if bp_p < 0.05 else 'Homoscedastic'})")

# ── Partial dependence plots ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(spline_cols), figsize=(5 * len(spline_cols), 4))
for i, col in enumerate(spline_cols):
    XX = gam_stage2_v2.generate_X_grid(term=i)
    axes[i].plot(XX[:, i], gam_stage2_v2.partial_dependence(term=i, X=XX))
    axes[i].plot(XX[:, i], gam_stage2_v2.partial_dependence(term=i, X=XX, width=0.95)[1],
                 c="r", ls="--", alpha=0.5)
    axes[i].set_title(f"Spline: {col}")
    axes[i].set_xlabel(col)
    axes[i].set_ylabel("Nonlinear Correction")
plt.suptitle("GAM v2 — Partial Dependence of Spline Corrections", fontsize=13)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# ── Segment labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
seg_labels = pd.Series("Land", index=train.index)
seg_labels[train["is_residential"] == 1] = "Residential"

# ── Diagnostic plots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 10))

axes[0,0].scatter(y_pred_gam_v2_train, resid_gam_v2, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#2980b9")

colors = {"Residential": "#2980b9", "Land": "#f39c12"}
for seg, col in colors.items():
    mask = seg_labels == seg
    axes[1,0].scatter(
```

```{python}
#| label: gam_v4

from pygam import LinearGAM, s
from functools import reduce
import operator
from sklearn.linear_model import ElasticNetCV
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from scipy import stats as scipy_stats
from statsmodels.stats.diagnostic import het_breuschpagan

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# GAM v3 — Two-Stage Hybrid + Segment Interactions + City Interactions
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Adds to v2:
#   • City slope interactions (eligible cities only, ≥100 train rows)
#   • City × key numeric predictors folded into ElasticNet Stage 1
#   • Everything else identical to v2

SPLINE_COLS = ["Total SqFt", "Year Built", "ln_Lot Acres", "Quality_Weighted"]
spline_cols = [c for c in SPLINE_COLS if c in X_train.columns]

# ── Start from v2 feature matrices ────────────────────────────────────────────
train_gam_v3 = train.copy()
test_gam_v3  = test.copy()

# ── Segment interactions (same as v2) ─────────────────────────────────────────
INTERACT_COLS = ["Total SqFt", "Year Built", "Quality_Weighted", "ln_Lot Acres"]
for col in INTERACT_COLS:
    if col in X_train.columns:
        train_gam_v3[f"res_x_{col}"] = X_train["is_residential"] * X_train[col]
        test_gam_v3[f"res_x_{col}"]  = X_test["is_residential"]  * X_test[col]

# ── Polynomial terms (same as v2) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
POLY_COLS = ["Total SqFt", "Year Built"]
for col in POLY_COLS:
    if col in X_train.columns:
        train_gam_v3[f"{col}_sq"] = X_train[col] ** 2
        test_gam_v3[f"{col}_sq"]  = X_test[col] ** 2

# ── City slope interactions (NEW in v3) ───────────────────────────────────────
EXCLUDE      = ["Trended_Price", "ln_Trended_Price"]
X_train_base = train_gam_v3.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).drop(columns=EXCLUDE, errors="ignore").fillna(0)
X_test_base  = test_gam_v3.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).drop(columns=EXCLUDE, errors="ignore").fillna(0)
X_test_base  = X_test_base.reindex(columns=X_train_base.columns, fill_value=0)

city_dummies    = [c for c in X_train_base.columns if c.startswith("City_")]
city_counts     = {c: int(X_train_base[c].sum()) for c in city_dummies}
eligible_cities = [c for c, n in city_counts.items() if n >= 100]
sparse_cities   = [c for c, n in city_counts.items() if n <  100]

print(f"\nCity dummies found : {len(city_dummies)}")
print(f"Eligible (≥100)    : {len(eligible_cities)}")
print(f"Sparse   (<100)    : {len(sparse_cities)}")
for c in eligible_cities:
    print(f"  {c:<40} : {city_counts[c]:>4} rows")

# Key numeric predictors to interact with City
CITY_INTERACT_PREDS = ["Total SqFt", "Year Built", "Quality_Weighted", "ln_Lot Acres",
                       "is_residential"]
interaction_count = 0
for city_col in eligible_cities:
    for pred_col in CITY_INTERACT_PREDS:
        if pred_col in X_train_base.columns:
            col_name = f"{city_col}_x_{pred_col}".replace(" ", "_")
            train_gam_v3[col_name] = X_train_base[city_col] * X_train_base[pred_col]
            test_gam_v3[col_name]  = X_test_base[city_col]  * X_test_base[pred_col]
            interaction_count += 1

print(f"\nCity interaction terms added : {interaction_count}")

# ── Rebuild final X matrices ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
X_train_v3_all = train_gam_v3.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).drop(columns=EXCLUDE, errors="ignore").fillna(0)
X_test_v3_all  = test_gam_v3.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).drop(columns=EXCLUDE, errors="ignore").fillna(0)
X_test_v3_all  = X_test_v3_all.reindex(columns=X_train_v3_all.columns, fill_value=0)

# ── Split into linear (Stage 1) vs spline (Stage 2) ──────────────────────────
linear_cols_v3   = [c for c in X_train_v3_all.columns if c not in spline_cols]
X_train_linear_v3 = X_train_v3_all[linear_cols_v3].values
X_test_linear_v3  = X_test_v3_all[linear_cols_v3].values
X_train_spline_v3 = X_train_v3_all[spline_cols].values
X_test_spline_v3  = X_test_v3_all[spline_cols].values

print(f"\nStage 1 (ElasticNet) : {len(linear_cols_v3)} predictors  (+city interactions vs v2)")
print(f"Stage 2 (GAM splines): {len(spline_cols)} — {spline_cols}")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STAGE 1 — ElasticNet with segment + city interactions
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
scaler_stage1_v3          = StandardScaler()
X_train_linear_v3_scaled  = scaler_stage1_v3.fit_transform(X_train_linear_v3)
X_test_linear_v3_scaled   = scaler_stage1_v3.transform(X_test_linear_v3)

enet_stage1_v3 = ElasticNetCV(
    l1_ratio     = [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 0.95, 1.0],
    alphas       = np.logspace(-4, 1, 50),

)
enet_stage1_v3.fit(X_train_linear_v3_scaled, y_train)

y_stage1_v3_train = enet_stage1_v3.predict(X_train_linear_v3_scaled)
y_stage1_v3_test  = enet_stage1_v3.predict(X_test_linear_v3_scaled)
resid_stage1_v3   = y_train.values - y_stage1_v3_train

print(f"\nStage 1 complete:")

print(f"  L1 ratio     : {enet_stage1_v3.l1_ratio_:.2f}")

print(f"  Train R²     : {r2_score(y_train, y_stage1_v3_train):.4f}")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STAGE 2 — GAM splines on Stage 1 residuals
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
spline_idx = list(range(len(spline_cols)))
gam_terms  = reduce(operator.add, [s(i, n_splines=20) for i in spline_idx])

gam_stage2_v3 = LinearGAM(gam_terms)

gam_stage2_v3.gridsearch(

best_lam_v3 = np.unique([round(float(l[0]), 4) for l in gam_stage2_v3.lam])

# ── Combined predictions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
y_spline_v3_train = gam_stage2_v3.predict(X_train_spline_v3)
y_spline_v3_test  = gam_stage2_v3.predict(X_test_spline_v3)

y_pred_gam_v3_train = y_stage1_v3_train + y_spline_v3_train
y_pred_gam_v3_test  = y_stage1_v3_test  + y_spline_v3_test

resid_gam_v3 = y_train.values - y_pred_gam_v3_train

ss_res = ((y_test.values - y_pred_gam_v3_test) ** 2).sum()
ss_tot = ((y_test.values - y_test.values.mean()) ** 2).sum()
r2_test_gam_v3  = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
r2_train_gam_v3 = r2_score(y_train, y_pred_gam_v3_train)

print("\n" + "=" * 50)

print("=" * 50)
print(f"  Stage 1 Train R² (ElasticNet) : {r2_score(y_train, y_stage1_v3_train):.4f}")

print(f"  Combined Test  R²             : {r2_test_gam_v3:.4f}")

print("=" * 50)

# ── Formal assumption tests ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
dw     = sm.stats.stattools.durbin_watson(resid_gam_v3)
```

```{python}
# Run this first to decide the threshold for GAM v4 area interactions

area_dummies = [c for c in X_train.columns if c.startswith("Area_")]
area_counts  = {c: int(X_train[c].sum()) for c in area_dummies}
area_counts_sorted = sorted(area_counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)

print(f"Total Area dummies found: {len(area_dummies)}")
print(f"\n{'Area':<45} | {'Train rows':>10}")
print("-" * 58)
for name, count in area_counts_sorted:
    print(f"  {name:<43} | {count:>10}")

print(f"\nSummary:")
print(f"  ≥100 rows : {sum(1 for _, n in area_counts_sorted if n >= 100)}")
print(f"  ≥ 50 rows : {sum(1 for _, n in area_counts_sorted if n >= 50)}")
print(f"  ≥ 25 rows : {sum(1 for _, n in area_counts_sorted if n >= 25)}")
print(f"  <  25 rows: {sum(1 for _, n in area_counts_sorted if n < 25)}")
```

```{python}
#| label: gam_v5

from pygam import LinearGAM, s
from functools import reduce
import operator
from sklearn.linear_model import ElasticNetCV
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from scipy import stats as scipy_stats
from statsmodels.stats.diagnostic import het_breuschpagan

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# GAM v5 — Two-Stage Hybrid + Segment + City + Area Interactions
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Adds to v4:
#   • Area slope interactions (eligible areas ≥50 train rows)
#   • Area × key numeric predictors folded into ElasticNet Stage 1
#   • ElasticNet L1 penalty prunes any non-useful interactions automatically

SPLINE_COLS = ["Total SqFt", "Year Built", "ln_Lot Acres", "Quality_Weighted"]
spline_cols = [c for c in SPLINE_COLS if c in X_train.columns]

# ── Start fresh from base train/test ──────────────────────────────────────────
train_gam_v4 = train.copy()
test_gam_v4  = test.copy()

# ── Segment interactions (same as v3/v4) ──────────────────────────────────────
INTERACT_COLS = ["Total SqFt", "Year Built", "Quality_Weighted", "ln_Lot Acres"]
for col in INTERACT_COLS:
    if col in X_train.columns:
        train_gam_v4[f"res_x_{col}"] = X_train["is_residential"] * X_train[col]
        test_gam_v4[f"res_x_{col}"]  = X_test["is_residential"]  * X_test[col]

# ── Polynomial terms (same as v2/v3) ──────────────────────────────────────────
POLY_COLS = ["Total SqFt", "Year Built"]
for col in POLY_COLS:
    if col in X_train.columns:
        train_gam_v4[f"{col}_sq"] = X_train[col] ** 2
        test_gam_v4[f"{col}_sq"]  = X_test[col] ** 2

# ── Build intermediate X to identify City and Area dummies ───────────────────
EXCLUDE = ["Trended_Price", "ln_Trended_Price"]
X_train_base = train_gam_v4.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).drop(columns=EXCLUDE, errors="ignore").fillna(0)
X_test_base  = test_gam_v4.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).drop(columns=EXCLUDE, errors="ignore").fillna(0)
X_test_base  = X_test_base.reindex(columns=X_train_base.columns, fill_value=0)

# ── City slope interactions (same as v4, ≥100) ────────────────────────────────
city_dummies    = [c for c in X_train_base.columns if c.startswith("City_")]
city_counts     = {c: int(X_train_base[c].sum()) for c in city_dummies}
eligible_cities = [c for c, n in city_counts.items() if n >= 100]

CITY_INTERACT_PREDS = ["Total SqFt", "Year Built", "Quality_Weighted",
                       "ln_Lot Acres", "is_residential"]
city_interaction_count = 0
for city_col in eligible_cities:
    for pred_col in CITY_INTERACT_PREDS:
        if pred_col in X_train_base.columns:
            col_name = f"{city_col}_x_{pred_col}".replace(" ", "_")
            train_gam_v4[col_name] = X_train_base[city_col] * X_train_base[pred_col]
            test_gam_v4[col_name]  = X_test_base[city_col]  * X_test_base[pred_col]
            city_interaction_count += 1

print(f"City interaction terms added : {city_interaction_count}")

# ── Area slope interactions (NEW in v5, ≥50) ──────────────────────────────────
area_dummies    = [c for c in X_train_base.columns if c.startswith("Area_")]
area_counts     = {c: int(X_train_base[c].sum()) for c in area_dummies}
eligible_areas  = [c for c, n in area_counts.items() if n >= 50]
sparse_areas    = [c for c, n in area_counts.items() if n <  50]

print(f"\nArea dummies found  : {len(area_dummies)}")
print(f"Eligible (≥50)      : {len(eligible_areas)}")
print(f"Sparse   (<50)      : {len(sparse_areas)}  (skipped)")
for c in eligible_areas:
    print(f"  {c:<40} : {area_counts[c]:>4} rows")

AREA_INTERACT_PREDS = ["Total SqFt", "Year Built", "Quality_Weighted",
                       "ln_Lot Acres", "is_residential"]
area_interaction_count = 0
for area_col in eligible_areas:
    for pred_col in AREA_INTERACT_PREDS:
        if pred_col in X_train_base.columns:
            col_name = f"{area_col}_x_{pred_col}".replace(" ", "_")
            train_gam_v4[col_name] = X_train_base[area_col] * X_train_base[pred_col]
            test_gam_v4[col_name]  = X_test_base[area_col]  * X_test_base[pred_col]
            area_interaction_count += 1

print(f"\nArea interaction terms added : {area_interaction_count}")

# ── Rebuild final X matrices ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
X_train_v4_all = train_gam_v4.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).drop(columns=EXCLUDE, errors="ignore").fillna(0)
X_test_v4_all  = test_gam_v4.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).drop(columns=EXCLUDE, errors="ignore").fillna(0)
X_test_v4_all  = X_test_v4_all.reindex(columns=X_train_v4_all.columns, fill_value=0)

# ── Split into linear (Stage 1) vs spline (Stage 2) ──────────────────────────
linear_cols_v4    = [c for c in X_train_v4_all.columns if c not in spline_cols]
X_train_linear_v4 = X_train_v4_all[linear_cols_v4].values
X_test_linear_v4  = X_test_v4_all[linear_cols_v4].values
X_train_spline_v4 = X_train_v4_all[spline_cols].values
X_test_spline_v4  = X_test_v4_all[spline_cols].values

print(f"\nStage 1 (ElasticNet) : {len(linear_cols_v4)} predictors  (+area interactions vs v3)")
print(f"Stage 2 (GAM splines): {len(spline_cols)} — {spline_cols}")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STAGE 1 — ElasticNet with segment + city + area interactions
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
scaler_stage1_v4         = StandardScaler()
X_train_linear_v4_scaled = scaler_stage1_v4.fit_transform(X_train_linear_v4)
X_test_linear_v4_scaled  = scaler_stage1_v4.transform(X_test_linear_v4)

enet_stage1_v4 = ElasticNetCV(
    l1_ratio     = [0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 0.95, 1.0],
    alphas       = np.logspace(-4, 1, 50),
    cv           = 5,
    max_iter     = 10000,
    random_state = 2026
)
enet_stage1_v4.fit(X_train_linear_v4_scaled, y_train)

y_stage1_v4_train = enet_stage1_v4.predict(X_train_linear_v4_scaled)
y_stage1_v4_test  = enet_stage1_v4.predict(X_test_linear_v4_scaled)
resid_stage1_v4   = y_train.values - y_stage1_v4_train

nonzero = (enet_stage1_v4.coef_ != 0).sum()
print(f"\nStage 1 complete:")
print(f"  Alpha        : {enet_stage1_v4.alpha_:.6f}")
print(f"  L1 ratio     : {enet_stage1_v4.l1_ratio_:.2f}")
print(f"  Non-zero     : {nonzero} / {len(enet_stage1_v4.coef_)}  ({len(enet_stage1_v4.coef_) - nonzero} zeroed out by ElasticNet)")
print(f"  Train R²     : {r2_score(y_train, y_stage1_v4_train):.4f}")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# STAGE 2 — GAM splines on Stage 1 residuals
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
spline_idx = list(range(len(spline_cols)))
gam_terms  = reduce(operator.add, [s(i, n_splines=20) for i in spline_idx])

gam_stage2_v4 = LinearGAM(gam_terms)
lam_grid      = np.logspace(-3, 5, 40)
gam_stage2_v4.gridsearch(
    X_train_spline_v4, resid_stage1_v4,
    lam=lam_grid,
    progress=False
)

best_lam_v4 = np.unique([round(float(l[0]), 4) for l in gam_stage2_v4.lam])
print(f"\nStage 2 complete:")
print(f"  Best lambda  : {best_lam_v4}")
print(f"  GCV Score    : {gam_stage2_v4.statistics_['GCV']:.6f}")

# ── Combined predictions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
y_spline_v4_train = gam_stage2_v4.predict(X_train_spline_v4)
y_spline_v4_test  = gam_stage2_v4.predict(X_test_spline_v4)

y_pred_gam_v4_train = y_stage1_v4_train + y_spline_v4_train
y_pred_gam_v4_test  = y_stage1_v4_test  + y_spline_v4_test

resid_gam_v4 = y_train.values - y_pred_gam_v4_train

ss_res = ((y_test.values - y_pred_gam_v4_test) ** 2).sum()
ss_tot = ((y_test.values - y_test.values.mean()) ** 2).sum()
r2_test_gam_v4  = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot
r2_train_gam_v4 = r2_score(y_train, y_pred_gam_v4_train)

print("\n" + "=" * 55)
print("  GAM v4 — Two-Stage + Segment + City + Area Interactions")
print("=" * 55)
print(f"  Stage 1 Train R² (ElasticNet) : {r2_score(y_train, y_stage1_v4_train):.4f}")
print(f"  Stage 2 correction added      : {r2_score(resid_stage1_v4, y_spline_v4_train):.4f} R² of residuals explained")
print(f"  Combined Train R²             : {r2_train_gam_v4:.4f}")
print(f"  Combined Test  R²             : {r2_test_gam_v4:.4f}")
print(f"  Train-Test gap                : {r2_train_gam_v4 - r2_test_gam_v4:.4f}")
print(f"\n  GAM v1 Test R²               : 0.7904  (baseline)")
print(f"  GAM v2 Test R²               : 0.7987  (+ segment interactions)")
print(f"  GAM v3 Test R²               : 0.8331  (+ city interactions)")
print(f"  GAM v4 Test R²               : {r2_test_gam_v4:.4f}  (+ area interactions)")
print(f"  Improvement over v3          : {r2_test_gam_v4 - 0.8331:+.4f}")
print("=" * 55)

# ── Formal assumption tests ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
dw = sm.stats.stattools.durbin_watson(resid_gam_v4)
bp_stat, bp_p, _, _ = het_breuschpagan(resid_gam_v4, sm.add_constant(X_train_v4_all.values))

print(f"\n  Residual skew         : {pd.Series(resid_gam_v4).skew():.3f}")
print(f"  Residual kurt         : {pd.Series(resid_gam_v4).kurt():.3f}")
print(f"  Residual std          : {resid_gam_v4.std():.4f}")
print(f"  Durbin-Watson         : {dw:.4f}  (2.0 = no autocorrelation)")
print(f"  Breusch-Pagan p-value : {bp_p:.4f} ({'Heteroscedastic' if bp_p < 0.05 else 'Homoscedastic'})")

# ── Partial dependence plots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(spline_cols), figsize=(5 * len(spline_cols), 4))
for i, col in enumerate(spline_cols):
    XX = gam_stage2_v4.generate_X_grid(term=i)
    axes[i].plot(XX[:, i], gam_stage2_v4.partial_dependence(term=i, X=XX))
    axes[i].plot(XX[:, i], gam_stage2_v4.partial_dependence(term=i, X=XX, width=0.95)[1],
                 c="r", ls="--", alpha=0.5)
    axes[i].set_title(f"Spline: {col}")
    axes[i].set_xlabel(col)
    axes[i].set_ylabel("Nonlinear Correction")
plt.suptitle("GAM v4 — Partial Dependence of Spline Corrections", fontsize=13)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# ── Segment labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
seg_labels_v4 = pd.Series("Land", index=train.index)
seg_labels_v4[train["is_residential"] == 1] = "Residential"

# ── Diagnostic plots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(16, 10))

axes[0,0].scatter(y_pred_gam_v4_train, resid_gam_v4, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#2980b9")
axes[0,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[0,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted")
axes[0,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[0,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")

(osm, osr), (slope, intercept, r) = scipy_stats.probplot(resid_gam_v4, dist="norm")
axes[0,1].scatter(osm, osr, alpha=0.3, s=8, color="#2980b9")
axes[0,1].plot(osm, slope * np.array(osm) + intercept, color="red")
axes[0,1].set_title("Normal Q-Q Plot")
axes[0,1].set_xlabel("Theoretical Quantiles")
axes[0,1].set_ylabel("Sample Quantiles")

sqrt_abs_resid_v4 = np.sqrt(np.abs(resid_gam_v4))
axes[0,2].scatter(y_pred_gam_v4_train, sqrt_abs_resid_v4, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#27ae60")
axes[0,2].set_title("Scale-Location (Homoscedasticity)")
axes[0,2].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[0,2].set_ylabel("√|Residuals|")

colors = {"Residential": "#2980b9", "Land": "#f39c12"}
for seg, col in colors.items():
    mask = seg_labels_v4 == seg
    axes[1,0].scatter(
        y_pred_gam_v4_train[mask], resid_gam_v4[mask],
        alpha=0.2, s=8, color=col, label=seg
    )
axes[1,0].axhline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,0].set_title("Residuals vs Fitted by Segment")
axes[1,0].set_xlabel("Fitted Values")
axes[1,0].set_ylabel("Residuals")
axes[1,0].legend()

axes[1,1].hist(resid_gam_v4, bins=60, color="#9b59b6", edgecolor="white")
axes[1,1].axvline(0, color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,1].set_title("Residual Distribution")
axes[1,1].set_xlabel("Residuals")
axes[1,1].set_ylabel("Count")

axes[1,2].scatter(y_test, y_pred_gam_v4_test, alpha=0.2, s=8, color="#e67e22")
axes[1,2].plot([y_test.min(), y_test.max()],
               [y_test.min(), y_test.max()], color="red", linestyle="--")
axes[1,2].set_title("Actual vs Predicted (Test Set)")
axes[1,2].set_xlabel("Actual ln(Trended_Price)")
axes[1,2].set_ylabel("Predicted ln(Trended_Price)")

plt.suptitle("GAM v4 — Two-Stage Hybrid + Segment + City + Area Interactions", fontsize=14)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# ── Segment-level performance ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
print("\n  Segment-Level Performance:")
print(f"  {'Segment':<15} | {'Train rows':>10} | {'Test rows':>9} | {'Train R²':>8} | {'Test R²':>8}")
print("  " + "-" * 65)
for seg_label, res_val in [("Residential", 1), ("Land", 0)]:
    mask_tr = (train["is_residential"] == res_val).values
    mask_te = (test["is_residential"]  == res_val).values
    y_tr   = y_train.values[mask_tr]
    y_te   = y_test.values[mask_te]
    y_p_tr = y_pred_gam_v4_train[mask_tr]
    y_p_te = y_pred_gam_v4_test[mask_te]
    ss_r   = ((y_te - y_p_te) ** 2).sum()
    ss_t   = ((y_te - y_te.mean()) ** 2).sum()
    print(f"  {seg_label:<15} | {mask_tr.sum():>10} | {mask_te.sum():>9} | {r2_score(y_tr, y_p_tr):>8.4f} | {1 - ss_r/ss_t:>8.4f}")
```
